Don't want to give out a lot of details yet but here are a few:

  • It will include realistic weapons with realistic weapon handling and ballistics. Probably less focus on weapon handling in 3rd person mode, but VR will have working chambers, actions and realistic magazines.
  • You won't be forced to do anything violent or immoral in the game, though you will also be free to cause as much mayhem as you're able to.
  • It's going to be mostly open ended, I will probably try to add some random tasks/quests for character but you'll be just as well off to go explore on your own.
  • It will be intended for mature audiences with as little censorship as I can get by with on steam.

I think open-world games frequently suffer from the fact that their content is stretched out too thinly across the playable world. I.e., there may be a shitload of locations, but no reason to visit 75% of them.
